notes.summary:
{
  "product": "Siri (Siri AI)",
  "current_pricing": "As of 2026-11-13, Siri AI is available at no additional cost on compatible devices, though Apple has officially confirmed that heavy usage of server-side features will be subject to daily usage limits and that expanded access will be available for a fee in the future. Pricing, specific limits, and subscription structures have not yet been published.",
  "platforms": [
    "iOS (iOS 27)",
    "iPadOS (iPadOS 27)",
    "macOS (macOS 27)",
    "watchOS (watchOS 27)",
    "visionOS (visionOS 27)"
  ],
  "main_features": [
    "Personal Context Awareness: Siri can retrieve information from personal apps like Photos, Mail, and Notes to answer context-specific queries.",
    "Systemwide App Actions: Ability to perform tasks across apps (e.g., editing messages, adding songs to playlists) without manual switching.",
    "Visual Intelligence: Integrated into the Camera app and across platforms to analyze, search, and take actions based on real-world or onscreen visual content.",
    "Conversational AI: Supports natural, multi-turn conversations and includes a dedicated Siri app to manage and pin ongoing discussions.",
    "Writing Tools: 'Write with Siri' helps compose, proofread, and adjust the tone of text virtually anywhere."
  ],
  "privacy_statements": "Siri AI is designed with a 'privacy-first' architecture that prioritizes on-device processing. For complex tasks requiring server-side models, Apple uses 'Private Cloud Compute,' which processes requests without storing data or making it accessible to Apple or third parties. Apple states it does not use Siri data to build marketing profiles or for advertising.",
  "reviewer_opinions": [
    "Praise: Reviewers appreciate the new conversational capabilities, the ability to perform cross-app actions, and the improved, more natural-sounding voice options with customizable pace and expressivity.",
    "Criticism: Some users report inconsistencies, such as 'silent failures' and errors in Visual Intelligence, with some finding it less effective at basic tasks than previous versions of Siri.",
    "Caveat: Reviewers note that the most advanced features are gated behind high-end hardware requirements (e.g., A19 Pro chips or M-series processors with 12GB+ RAM), limiting access for many users."
  ],
  "key_statistics": [
    {
      "description": "Estimated number of Siri users in the United States in 2026",
      "value": "86.5 million",
      "source": "dazzle.ai (July 2026)"
    },
    {
      "description": "Cumulative Apple Intelligence-capable iPhones shipped by Q1 2026",
      "value": "Over 450 million",
      "source": "xtendedview.com (September 2026)"
    },
    {
      "description": "Global active Apple device base entering 2026",
      "value": "Over 2.5 billion",
      "source": "xtendedview.com (September 2026)"
    }
  ],
  "caveats": "Siri AI is currently in beta and its availability is limited by region (e.g., not initially available in the EU for iOS/iPadOS/watchOS) and language support. Additionally, sources indicate that while Apple has confirmed future fees for expanded access, no specific pricing or capacity limits have been officially published as of November 2026."
}
